snippet.title: S.K.I.L.L. Special Force 2 is Globally back! (with subtitles)
snippet.description:
Description:

S.K.I.L.L. Special Force 2 Comes Back Globally! You will find it out here and much more! Simply see the video!

S.K.I.L.L. - Special Force 2 is a fast-paced, action-packed shooter based on the Unreal Engine 3. The game features a wide range of game modes, tons of maps and a huge selection of weapons.
The game comes with regular content updates including new maps, game modes, weapons and other improvements!

------------------------------------------------------------
Music
● Cinematic Action Dramatic by Infraction [No Copyright Music]
● https://youtu.be/HhtRukR0pSs
